text: The Goa Staff Selection Commission Act, 2019 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201911 Act Number: 11 Enactment Date: 2019-09-10 Act Year: 2019 Short Title: The Goa Staff Selection Commission Act, 2019 Long Title: To provide for the constitution of Goa Staff Selection Commission for the purpose of conducting examinations and selection of candidates for appointments to the subordinate services/posts in the Government Departments, and also to provide the procedure to be followed by the Goa Staff Selection Commission, its functions and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
